title: Selected letters as particles
blurb: Select text in a canvas and its letters come loose, fall into a pile, swirl and return. Each letter is a Range rectangle, drawn from a snapshot or from the live element through a clip. The DOM text does not change.
question: Can a canvas take single characters out of an element's picture and draw them somewhere else, while the text stays whole in the DOM?
result: Yes, with one Range per character and an even-odd clip.
